summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a November 4, 2026 news release announcing its board declared a quarterly common share dividend of C$1.00 per share, a 4-cent increase over the prior quarter's payout, payable December 31, 2026 to holders of record November 25, 2026. Preferred share dividends across Series 3, 4, 5, 8R, 9QR and 10R were also declared on the same dates and designated eligible dividends under the Income Tax Act (Canada). Dividends under the Canadian DRIP will be reinvested via open-market TSX purchases. The filing is a routine dividend declaration, not a tender or buyback; watch for further payout growth and DRIP activity, with no arbitrage angle.
